respondToExpiry.body: 30 days before expiry, call the metrology laboratory and send the instrument. Use a spare during verification.

equipment_calibration.legalRef: Rosstandart Order No. 2510 of 02.07.2015 and verification procedures.

equipment_maintenance.whoFills: An engineer or technician, according to schedule.
equipment_maintenance.whenToFill: According to each appliance’s schedule, usually monthly or quarterly.

checkSchedule.title: Check the schedule
checkSchedule.body: Check which equipment is scheduled for today.

performMaintenance.title: Perform maintenance
performMaintenance.body: Use the manufacturer’s checklist: cleaning, lubrication, component checks and parameter measurements.

recordResult.title: Record the result
recordResult.body: Record work done, findings and whether anything needs replacement.

describeIncident.title: Describe the incident
describeIncident.body: Appliance, symptoms, start date and who noticed it.

recordActions.title: Record actions
recordActions.body: Who repaired it, replacements, repair cost and date returned to service.

glass_items_list.intro: An inventory of glass and brittle plastic items: lights, glasses, carafes and jars. Create it once and update it when things change.
glass_items_list.whenToFill: When the business opens and when items are added or removed.

walkRooms.title: Walk through every room
walkRooms.body: Kitchen, storeroom, dining room, bar and toilets. Record every glass or brittle item.

registerItems.title: Enter items in the register
registerItems.body: Name, room, quantity and optional photograph.

glass_control.intro: The glass inspection journal. Compare with the inventory every day to confirm all items are intact. If anything breaks, find all fragments and record it.
glass_control.whoFills: The person on shift duty, a cook or cleaner.
glass_control.whenToFill: Daily, at the start and end of the shift.

checkInventory.title: Check against the register
checkInventory.body: Are all listed items present and intact? If not, find the fragments.

handleBreakage.title: If an item breaks
handleBreakage.body: Collect ALL fragments. Record the item, time and circumstances. If any fragments are missing, dispose of food in the area due to the foreign matter risk.

glass_control.legalRef: HACCP critical control point for physical hazards.

training_plan.intro: Annual staff training and briefing plan.

listTopics.title: List training topics
listTopics.body: SanPiN, HACCP, fire safety, occupational safety and site-specific requirements.

assignDatesAndTrainers.title: Assign dates and trainers
assignDatesAndTrainers.body: Who teaches, when and for whom: all staff, new starters or specialists.

staff_training.intro: A briefing register. Each employee signs to confirm completion.
staff_training.whoFills: The manager makes the entry; employees sign.
staff_training.whenToFill: Induction at hiring, initial workplace training, refresher every 6 months and unscheduled training after an incident.

giveBriefing.title: Give the briefing
giveBriefing.body: In person or recorded, using a video and test.

recordBriefing.title: Record in the journal
recordBriefing.body: Date, topic, instructor and participants, with signatures.

ppe_issuance.whenToFill: When PPE is issued to an employee.

issuePpe.title: Issue PPE
issuePpe.body: Gloves, apron, mask, headwear and footwear.

recordIssue.title: Record in the journal
recordIssue.body: Employee, date, items issued and quantity. Employee’s signature.

accident_journal.intro: A register of accidents and emergencies: fire, injury, food poisoning and power cuts.
accident_journal.whenToFill: Immediately after the incident, within 24 hours.

describeIncident.title: Describe the incident
describeIncident.body: Date, time, location, what happened and who was injured.

recordImmediateActions.title: Record immediate actions
recordImmediateActions.body: What was done immediately. For example, a burn was treated and the person taken to the injury clinic.

preventRecurrence.title: Prevent recurrence
preventRecurrence.body: Measures to prevent a repeat, for example a new protective screen on the cooker.

complaint_register.whoFills: The dining room manager or administrator.

recordActions.title: Record actions
recordActions.body: What was done: replacement dish, discount or apology. Was the problem resolved?

analyseCauses.title: Analyse causes
analyseCauses.body: Repeated complaints on the same topic require corrective actions such as training or changing the supplier.

pest_control.intro: Insect and rodent control journal. Record contractor visits and internal inspections for signs of rodents or insects.
pest_control.whenToFill: At every contractor visit and for daily inspections.

recordContractorVisit.title: Record the contractor’s visit
recordContractorVisit.body: Date, company name, specialist’s full name, work done, products used and completion report.

inspectInternally.title: Conduct internal inspections
inspectInternally.body: Check daily for rodent signs (droppings, gnawing) and insects (traces in flour or spices). If found, request an unscheduled contractor visit.

pest_control.legalRef: Sanitary Rules 3.5.3.3223-14, “Sanitary and epidemiological requirements for organising and performing rodent control”.

listTopics.title: List audit topics
listTopics.body: Hygiene, temperature control, HACCP, traceability, PPE and training.

scheduleMonths.title: Assign months
scheduleMonths.body: Audit every topic at least annually.

audit_protocol.intro: Internal audit minutes: checks performed, findings and checklist scores.
audit_protocol.whoFills: The auditor, a technologist or external expert.

completeChecklist.title: Work through the checklist
completeChecklist.body: Score each item on a scale, for example 0–3.

audit_report.intro: Audit results report with CAPA corrective actions.
audit_report.whoFills: The same auditor and the manager.

summariseFindings.title: Summarise the recorded findings
summariseFindings.body: Provide a summary for each category.

planCapa.title: CAPA: correction plan
planCapa.body: What will be corrected, by whom and by when, with completion monitoring.

cleaning.intro: The daily room cleaning journal confirms that each room was cleaned at the right time, with the right product and by the assigned person.
cleaning.whoFills: The cleaner or kitchen worker who cleaned the area, followed by a check from the senior cleaner or manager.
cleaning.whenToFill: After each routine cleaning, several times daily, and final cleaning in the evening after the shift.

prepare.colourCodedTools: Area-specific cloths: green for floors, white for surfaces, blue for toilets
prepare.approvedProducts: Detergent and disinfectant from the approved list

chooseEquipment.title: Take the correct cleaning equipment
chooseEquipment.body: Area separation is mandatory. NEVER use a toilet cloth in the kitchen: this violates SanPiN.

goToAssignedArea.title: Go to the assigned area
goToAssignedArea.body: The task names the area. If it says “Cold kitchen”, that means that specific room. Do not confuse it with another.

cleanTopToBottom.title: Clean from top to bottom
cleanTopToBottom.body: Windowsills → tables → cupboards → refrigerator handles → floor. Work from the far corner towards the exit.

photographResult.title: Photograph the result
photographResult.body: Take 1 overall photo and 1 floor photo as evidence for the inspector.
photographResult.tip: Photos without dates are not accepted; the system automatically adds a timestamp to EXIF.

completeChecklist.title: Complete the journal checklist
completeChecklist.body: Area ✓, product selected from the list ✓, photo ✓, signature with your name filled automatically.

routineCleaning.label: Routine cleaning
routineCleaning.value: Cold kitchen, 14:30, Profimax 2%, photo attached, cleaned by Petrova K.

mistakes.sharedCloth: Using one cloth for all areas causes bacterial cross-contamination
mistakes.missingPhoto: No photographs means no evidence of cleaning
mistakes.wrongSigner: One person cleans and another completes the journal: the signature does not match

cleaning.legalRef: SanPiN 2.3/2.4.4282-26 and the production control programme.

general_cleaning.intro: Monthly deep cleaning journal: dismantling equipment, washing ceilings, changing oil in extraction hoods and disinfecting.
general_cleaning.whoFills: The cleaning team, checked by the manager. All participants and the manager sign.
general_cleaning.whenToFill: On the room’s scheduled dates, which may occur several times a month, such as every Friday. The worker receives a TasksFlow task on cleaning day. Afterwards, mark the date completed through the task or journal. Cleaning takes 4–8 hours.

prepare.strongDisinfectants: Stronger disinfectants, such as chlorine-based Sanit Star
prepare.closedKitchen: Suspend normal operations: the kitchen closes for the day

clearRooms.title: Clear the rooms
clearRooms.body: Put all food in refrigerators labelled “Do not touch”. Dismantle equipment.

cleanCeilingsWalls.title: Clean ceilings and walls
cleanCeilingsWalls.body: Wet-clean with disinfectant. Dismantle ceiling extraction hoods and wash them separately.

cleanEquipment.title: Clean equipment
cleanEquipment.body: Refrigerators: inside, outside and behind. Cooker burners and grates: soak in a sink. Mixers and slicers: dismantle into parts.

cleanFloors.title: Clean floors
cleanFloors.body: Clean twice: first normal wet cleaning, then disinfectant with 30 minutes of contact time.

signReport.title: Sign the report
signReport.body: All participants and the manager sign. Record the date, start and finish times, areas cleaned and disinfectants used.

scheduledCleaning.label: Scheduled deep cleaning
scheduledCleaning.value: 12.04, hot and cold kitchens, 09:00–15:30. Chlorine-based product, 0.2%, contact time 30 min. Participants: Petrova K., Smirnova O. Checked by manager Orlova N. No concerns.

finding.label: With a finding
finding.value: Dry store: rodent activity found behind shelving. Action: area treated, rodent control service called, request No. 31; reinspection on 15.04.

mistakes.rushedDuringShift: Rushing deep cleaning during a normal shift means equipment is not dismantled and the result is superficial
mistakes.missingTreatmentDetails: Omitting the disinfectant, concentration or contact time means the entry does not confirm treatment
mistakes.foodLeftInRoom: Leaving food in the room during disinfectant treatment
mistakes.singleSignature: One signature for the entire report instead of every participant and the checker
mistakes.unrecordedPostponement: Skipping a month without recording postponement leaves an obvious gap in the journal

pestSigns.trigger: Signs of insects or rodents found
pestSigns.action: Record the location and signs, call insect or rodent control, and isolate and inspect food from the area. Record the request number and reinspection date.

mould.action: Treat with fungicide, find the moisture source (leak or weak ventilation) and fix it. Otherwise mould will return by the next deep clean.

cleaning_ventilation_checklist.intro: A room cleaning and ventilation checklist for shift opening and closing. It confirms that the room is ready for work, with fresh air, clean surfaces and working ventilation, and is properly closed after the shift.
cleaning_ventilation_checklist.whoFills: The shift duty person: cleaner, kitchen worker or shift manager. The same person marks and signs the checklist.
cleaning_ventilation_checklist.whenToFill: At least twice per working day: at opening, before production starts, and at closing. For windowless rooms, follow the supply and extraction ventilation schedule.

prepare.zonedTools: Area-specific equipment: colour-coded cloths and a labelled bucket
prepare.productsAndMeasure: Approved detergent and disinfectant, plus a measuring container
prepare.ventilationAccess: Access to windows or transoms and ventilation controls
prepare.phone: Phone for photographs and calling maintenance if ventilation fails

assessAir.title: Open the room and assess the air
assessAir.body: Enter before switching on equipment. Unusual smells (burning, mustiness or sewage) are already deviations: record them instead of merely airing the room and forgetting.

ventilate.title: Ventilate
ventilate.body: Open windows or transoms for 15–20 minutes. If there are no windows, switch on supply and extraction ventilation and check airflow: paper should be drawn towards the grille.
ventilate.tip: In cold weather, ventilate before staff arrive so the temperature returns to normal by the start of work.

inspectGrilles.title: Check grilles and extraction hoods
inspectGrilles.body: Grilles must be free of dust and grease, hood filters fitted and unblocked, and the grease trap not overflowing. Dust on a grille shows ventilation is not cleaned: inspectors check this early.

checkEachArea.title: Work through the checklist by area
checkEachArea.body: For each item: look → assess → mark. Check floors, walls up to working height, windowsills, door and refrigerator handles, sinks and waste bins (lid closed and bag replaced).
checkEachArea.tip: Do not tick everything at once. The system records time, and completing an entire checklist in 5 seconds looks like a formality.

recordDeviations.title: Record deviations and corrective action
recordDeviations.body: Every “No” needs a comment: what is wrong, what was done now and what maintenance must do. If repair is needed, state who received the request and when.

saveAsYourself.title: Save under your own name
saveAsYourself.body: The signature is the account used to complete the checklist. Do not complete it for a colleague: the signature would not match the person who did the work.

openingNormal.label: Shift opening, no concerns
openingNormal.value: 08:00, hot kitchen. Aired for 20 min; ventilation working; grilles clean; floors and surfaces washed with Profimax 2%; waste removed. All items ✓.

weakExtraction.label: Weak extraction
weakExtraction.value: Pastry kitchen: weak extraction, greasy hood filter. Action: filter removed and soaked, maintenance request No. 12 dated 12.04; work continued with an open window. Recheck at 16:00.

closingShift.label: Shift closing
closingShift.value: 22:10, all areas cleaned, waste removed, windows closed, ventilation switched to night mode, UV lamp switched on for 30 min.

mistakes.tickingAhead: Ticking the whole shift’s checklist in advance at the start of the shift
mistakes.falseVentilation: Marking “Ventilated” with windows closed and ventilation switched off
mistakes.missingRepairAction: Writing “Extraction not working” without corrective action or a request number
mistakes.sharedToiletEquipment: Using the same tools in production and toilets directly violates area separation
mistakes.signingForOthers: Completing a colleague’s checklist: the signature must belong to the person who cleaned

extractionStopped.action: Record the time and call maintenance the same day. Limit heavy steaming and frying until restored and provide natural ventilation. Record when the fault is fixed.

sewageSmell.trigger: Sewage smell in a production room
sewageSmell.action: Stop handling exposed food in the area and call a plumber. A dry water trap or blockage is the usual cause. Until fixed, the area is unsuitable for food preparation.

greaseBuildup.trigger: Grease buildup in the extraction hood
greaseBuildup.action: Clean filters immediately and wash the hood outside the normal schedule. This is both a sanitary and a fire risk.

cleaning_ventilation_checklist.legalRef: SanPiN 2.3/2.4.4282-26 (cleaning and upkeep of premises); the organisation’s production control programme.

uv_lamp_runtime.intro: UV germicidal unit runtime journal. The lamp must operate for the prescribed time each shift to disinfect the air.
uv_lamp_runtime.whoFills: The person switching the lamp on and off, usually the cleaner or duty cook.
uv_lamp_runtime.whenToFill: Every time the lamp is switched on and off.

switchOn.title: Switch on the lamp
switchOn.body: Record the start time. The room must be empty: UV is dangerous to eyes and skin.
switchOn.tip: After switching on, close the door and display “Do not enter: treatment in progress”.

switchOff.title: Switch off the lamp
switchOff.body: Record the stop time. The minimum runtime is in the lamp manual, usually 15–60 minutes.

recordRuntime.title: Record accumulated runtime
recordRuntime.body: Track total operating hours. Replace the lamp when its rated life is reached, usually 8000 hours.

normalCycle.label: Normal cycle
normalCycle.value: 12.04, cold kitchen, unit No. 1. On 08:10, off 08:40, runtime 30 min. Accumulated runtime: 1 240 h. Operator: Petrova K.

nearEndOfLife.label: Approaching rated life
nearEndOfLife.value: Unit No. 2, runtime 7 850 h out of 8 000 h. Comment: “Replacement lamp ordered, invoice No. 145, replacement planned for 20.04”.

mistakes.noTimes: Recording “Switched on” without start and finish times prevents runtime calculation
mistakes.noCumulativeTotal: Not tracking cumulative hours: an exhausted lamp may still appear to work but no longer disinfects
mistakes.peoplePresent: Switching on an open-type UV unit while people are in the room
mistakes.retrospectiveRecords: Backdating a week’s entries makes the recorded runtime fictional
mistakes.dustOnLamp: Not removing dust from the lamp: dust significantly reduces germicidal output

personPresent.trigger: Lamp on with an employee in the room
personPresent.action: Switch off urgently and remove the person. Prolonged UV exposure can burn the retina and skin. If exposure exceeded 5 minutes, see an ophthalmologist.

finished_product.intro: Finished-food acceptance is a mandatory check of every dish before service and a HACCP critical control point. A commission of 3 people performs the check.
finished_product.whoFills: The acceptance commission: head chef, sous-chef or second cook, and manager. At least 3 signatures.
finished_product.whenToFill: Before each dish is sent to the dining room or delivery. For continuous service, take grouped samples by shift.

checkAppearance.title: Check the dish’s appearance
checkAppearance.body: Colour must match the recipe: borscht should be burgundy, not pale. The shape must be correct and presentation meet the standard.

checkSmell.title: Check the smell
checkSmell.body: Fresh and appetising, without unusual smells such as mould, rancidity or chemicals.

checkTaste.title: Check the taste
checkTaste.body: Salt, spices and main flavour must match the recipe. Unusual flavours such as burnt food, frying oil or sourness mean rejection.

checkServingTemperature.title: Check the serving temperature
checkServingTemperature.body: Hot dishes >+65°C, measured at the centre with a probe. Cold dishes <+14°C. Reheat or cool if outside these limits.
checkServingTemperature.tip: Hot food below +65°C breaches HACCP requirements and allows bacteria to multiply.

recordCommissionDecision.title: Record the commission’s decision
recordCommissionDecision.body: “Cleared for sale” or “Rejected”, with the reason. All 3 members sign.

cleared.label: Cleared
cleared.value: Ukrainian borscht: rich colour, fresh smell, balanced flavour, t°=72°C. Cleared. Head chef/Sous-chef/Manager ✓

rejected.label: Rejected
rejected.value: Chicken Kyiv: butter leaked because the coating split. Reject the whole batch (12 pieces) and remake. Cause: coating too thin.

mistakes.recordingBeforeCooking: Completing the acceptance record before the dish is cooked
mistakes.singleSignature: Using one signature instead of all commission members’ signatures
mistakes.missingTemperature: Omitting serving temperature, a key control parameter for hot dishes
mistakes.blanketShiftApproval: One “No concerns” entry for the whole shift instead of checking each item
mistakes.missingRejectionDetails: Rejecting a dish without its reason and quantity leaves no evidence for the write-off

lowServingTemperature.trigger: A hot dish is below +65°C at service
lowServingTemperature.action: Remove from service, reheat to a safe temperature and measure again. If it has stood warm for more than two hours, dispose of it and record the write-off.

unusualTasteSmell.action: Reject the whole batch, identify the source (raw materials, oil, utensils or containers) and record the reason. Check the same ingredients remaining in other dishes.

foreignMatter.trigger: Foreign matter found in a dish
foreignMatter.action: Immediately withdraw and isolate the entire batch, record it and investigate utensils, packaging or glass. For glass, also complete the glass inspection journal.

incoming_control.intro: Product receiving and incoming inspection journal. Its main purpose is to keep spoiled or expired raw materials out of storage.
incoming_control.whoFills: The commodity expert, storekeeper or production manager who accepts the delivery from the courier.
incoming_control.whenToFill: On every delivery, before signing the delivery note.

prepare.thermometer: Thermometer to check delivery temperature for perishables
prepare.conformityDeclaration: Declaration of conformity for regulated product groups

checkDeliveryNote.title: Check the delivery note
checkDeliveryNote.body: Check product name, quantity, price and supplier. If they do not match, do NOT accept or record the discrepancy in “Notes”.

checkPackaging.title: Check packaging
checkPackaging.body: It must be intact, without dents, leaks or tears, and the label must be legible.

checkExpiry.title: Check shelf life
checkExpiry.body: At least 70% of shelf life must remain on arrival, or 50% for meat and fish. Otherwise do NOT accept.

measureTemperature.title: Measure perishable temperatures
measureTemperature.body: Meat: ≤+4°C. Dairy: ≤+6°C. Frozen food: ≤−12°C on delivery; storage at −18°C.
measureTemperature.tip: Reject if the temperature is higher. The supplier broke the cold chain, creating a contamination risk.

recordReceipt.title: Record in the journal
recordReceipt.body: Supplier, product, quantity, batch number, production date, expiry date, receiving temperature, certificate number and decision: accept or reject.

accepted.label: Accepted
accepted.value: Beef (Miratorg), 25 kg, batch 240412, use by 22.04, t°=+2°C, certificate No. 1234. Accepted.

rejected.label: Rejected
rejected.value: Milk (MolKom), 50 L, t°=+12°C (limit ≤+6). Rejected, return report completed.

mistakes.signingBeforeInspection: Signing before inspecting makes it impossible to raise a later supplier claim
mistakes.missingReceivingTemperature: Recording only “Accepted” without the receiving temperature for perishables
mistakes.missingDocuments: Accepting goods without quality and safety documents
mistakes.missingBatch: Omitting the batch number leaves nothing to trace during a recall
mistakes.weeklyRetrospective: Entering deliveries from memory at the end of the week

damagedPackaging.action: Reject the item. Record the reason, note rejection on the delivery note and photograph the packaging.

highDeliveryTemperature.action: Reject perishables. Record the measured value and limit, and notify the supplier in writing. Do not use the product even for heat treatment.

insufficientShelfLife.trigger: Remaining shelf life is below the requirement
insufficientShelfLife.action: Reject, or accept only with written approval and a plan to sell within the shelf life. Record the decision and expiry date in the journal.

incoming_control.legalRef: Customs Union Technical Regulation 021/2011, Article 10; SanPiN 2.3/2.4.4282-26.

perishable_rejection.intro: Acceptance journal for perishable raw materials and semi-finished products. Record the batch’s sensory assessment and decision: release to production, return to the supplier or dispose. This proves that questionable raw materials did not enter the kitchen.
perishable_rejection.whoFills: The head chef, production manager or commodity expert. Disposal of a large batch requires a commission of 2–3 people and their signatures.
perishable_rejection.whenToFill: On receiving perishables and whenever quality is in doubt: changed smell, expiry or a breach of storage temperatures.

prepare.samplingTools: Clean knife and chopping board for a test sample
prepare.batchDocuments: Delivery note and batch label: production date, expiry date and batch number
prepare.scales: Scales to record the quantity being written off
prepare.lighting: Good lighting: yellow light distorts the assessment of colour and slime

checkLabelAndExpiry.title: Check the label and shelf life
checkLabelAndExpiry.body: Check production date, expiry date, storage conditions and batch number. Expired raw materials are rejected immediately, without further quality assessment.

measureTemperature.title: Measure product temperature
measureTemperature.body: Insert the probe into the product, not its packaging. Chilled meat and fish: up to +4…+6°C; dairy: up to +6°C; frozen food: no warmer than −12°C on receipt. Record deviations numerically in “Notes”, not as “warm”; the form has no separate temperature column.

inspectAppearancePackaging.title: Assess appearance and packaging
inspectAppearancePackaging.body: Packaging must be intact without leaks or swelling; the surface colour natural, with no mould, film or slime. Frozen products must show no refreezing signs such as ice buildup or distorted blocks.

assessSmellConsistency.title: Assess smell and consistency
assessSmellConsistency.body: For meat, use a warmed knife inside the piece; the smell must be characteristic of fresh meat. Fish: clear cornea, red gills, firm flesh, no swollen belly. Dairy: no unusual sour or yeasty notes.
assessSmellConsistency.tip: Doubt is already a finding. Heat treatment does not rescue borderline raw materials: some toxins are heat-stable.

decideAndIsolate.title: Decide and separate the batch
decideAndIsolate.body: Choose “Released to production”, “Return to supplier” or “Disposal”. Immediately remove rejected materials from usable food storage and label “REJECTED — do not use”.

recordAndDocument.title: Record and prepare documents
recordAndDocument.body: Record product, supplier, batch number, production and expiry dates, quantity (kg/units), measured temperature, specific reason, decision, full names and signatures. For returns, complete a return report and delivery-note mark; for disposal, a write-off report.

released.label: Released
released.value: Chilled chicken fillet, batch 240412, use by 15.04, 18 kg, t=+3.2°C. Pink, characteristic smell, no slime. Released to production. Head chef Sokolov A.

returned.label: Return to supplier
returned.value: Sour cream 20%, 15 kg, t=+11°C with a ≤+6 limit. Swollen packaging on 4 tubs. Decision: return to supplier, report No. 7 dated 12.04, driver notified, goods not booked into stock.

disposal.label: Disposal
disposal.value: Chilled trout, 6 kg, expired 11.04, brown gills, musty smell. Decision: disposal, write-off report No. 3, commission: head chef, commodity expert, manager.

mistakes.vagueAssessment: “Quality satisfactory” without temperature, quantity and batch number proves nothing
mistakes.rejectedStockNotIsolated: Leaving a rejected batch in the shared refrigerator until evening risks it being used
mistakes.cookingBorderlineStock: Using borderline raw materials for soup or thorough frying instead of writing them off
mistakes.retrospectiveRejection: Recording rejection after disposal, when nothing remains to inspect
mistakes.missingReports: Omitting return or write-off reports leaves accounting and inspectors with different figures

brokenColdChain.trigger: Delivery arrived warm after a cold-chain breach
brokenColdChain.action: Reject. Record the temperature, photograph the thermometer beside the product, complete a return and notify the supplier in writing. Repeated breaches justify changing supplier.

spoilageDuringProduction.trigger: Spoilage found after the batch entered production
spoilageDuringProduction.action: Stop preparation, withdraw all dishes made from the batch, isolate remaining materials and document rejection and write-off. Record the time and withdrawn items.

swollenPackaging.trigger: Swollen vacuum packs or canned products
swollenPackaging.action: Do not open or taste. Isolate and dispose of it due to the risk of clostridia. Notify the supplier, stating the batch number.

perishable_rejection.legalRef: Customs Union Technical Regulation 021/2011, “Food safety” (Articles 7 and 10); Technical Regulation 034/2013 (meat); SanPiN 2.3/2.4.4282-26.

finishedProduct.title: Finished food quality inspection journal
finishedProduct.archiveTemperatureTitle: Food quality inspection journal with temperature
finishedProduct.qualityTitle: Recommendations for organizing finished food quality control

quality.method: Food quality is checked using sensory assessment.
quality.conditions: Inspect food in daylight where possible; assess smell and taste at the dish’s usual temperature.
quality.thermometers: Use only functioning probe thermometers to measure temperature.
quality.B: Minced meat products: cutlets, patties, meatballs, stuffed patties
quality.E: Whole cuts of beef, lamb, fish for cold consumption

time.chain: Preparation → inspection after {rejection, number} min → release permission after {release, number} min
time.chainEmpty: Enter the preparation time; inspection and release times will be calculated automatically
time.chainNoRelease: Inspection at {time}, with no release permission ({minutes, number} min later; adjustable in journal settings)
time.chainRelease: Inspection at {time}, release permission at {releaseTime} ({minutes, number} and {releaseMinutes, number} min later; adjustable in journal settings)

people.choose: Select an employee or enter a full name
people.inspectorFull: Full name of the person who performed the inspection

fields.courierDateTime: Date and time dishes were handed to the courier
fields.courierFull: Time dishes were handed to the courier

hints.menuTime: Preparation time is from the “{menu}” menu. Adjust it if today is different.
hints.previous: From the previous record “{name}”. Adjust it if today is different.
hints.menuPortion: Portion weight is from the “{menu}” menu. Adjust it if today is different.

commission.title: Commission
commission.signHint: After saving, your assessment and signature appear in the journal, one minute after the inspection time. The dish leaves the queue after every commission member assesses it.
commission.memberHint: Commission members sign each dish themselves using the journal QR code (PIN) or the checkbox in this window.
commission.heading: Food inspection commission members:
commission.notSet: No members assigned; rows are closed without a commission signature
commission.outdatedTitle: The row was changed after signing

actions.deleteDescription: The inspection records will be removed from the journal after saving.
actions.deleteSigned: Signed by the commission: {count, number}; signatures will remain in the signature log
actions.unnamedSelection: The selected records have no product name
actions.addSeveralHint: Empty rows with the current date and time will be added. You only need to enter the names.
actions.positiveInteger: Enter a whole number greater than zero
actions.maxRows: You can add no more than {count, number} rows at a time
actions.saveNextHint: Save this product and open a blank row with the same time, assessment and people

empty.closed: Move the journal back to active to add inspection records again.
empty.deleteHint: Journal rows will be permanently deleted

settings.title: Document settings
settings.description: Table columns and the note below the journal.
settings.timeDescription: Times for a new row: preparation is {production, number} min before the window opens; inspection is {rejection, number} min after preparation; release permission is {release, number} min after inspection. You can always adjust the row’s times manually.
settings.releaseOffset: Release permission — N minutes after inspection
settings.gradeDescription: Sensory assessment options. Leave empty to use the defaults: {options}.
settings.semiOptions: for semi-finished products (compliant / requires rework / non-compliant)

catalog.title: Product list
catalog.description: These products will appear in the dropdown when adding a journal row.
catalog.empty: The list is empty. Enter a product name below and press “+”.
catalog.masterHint: Items marked “Master workspace” are sent by the back office using the directory code. It is easier to update the menu there.
catalog.masterItemHint: This item was sent by the master directory workspace. If deleted here, it will return with the next update.
catalog.fromOrganizationHint: Add products from the organization’s shared directory

list.products: Products in the document directory: {count, number}

errors.saveScreenOnly: Could not save the journal; changes are only on the screen
errors.network: Cannot connect to the server. Check your internet connection and try again

errors.reason: Describe the reason for the deviation

pipeline.lowCooking: Temperature {temperature}°C is below the heat treatment limit (≥ 70°C). Check it or explain the reason in the final step’s comment.
pipeline.lowServing: SanPiN requires hot dishes to be served at no less than 65°C. The current value is {temperature}°C. Check the thermometer.
pipeline.progressToast: Completed {count, number}. Ready for the next dish.
pipeline.remainingToast: Completed {count, number}, {remaining, number} remaining before the limit.
pipeline.capReached: The limit of {count, number} records per day has been reached. The record was saved, but no new task was created.
pipeline.title: Quality inspection cycle — record every finished dish
pipeline.batchHint: Enter a batch number or marking if available. Otherwise, leave blank.
pipeline.sourceHint: Where the product came from: storage, refrigerator No. 2, or a delivery received from a supplier.
pipeline.cookingHint: SanPiN specifies at least 70°C at the core of most dishes.
pipeline.startHint: The current time is filled in; you can change it.
pipeline.assessHint: Assess each parameter separately. SanPiN clause 2.5 requires 4 categories: appearance, smell, taste and consistency.
pipeline.decisionHint: If any sensory assessment is Satisfactory or Unsatisfactory, the system suggests a decision. You can change it.
pipeline.reason: Reason for deviation and actions taken
pipeline.reasonHint: Describe the problem and action taken: added seasoning, sent for rework or written off.
pipeline.reasonPlaceholder: For example: “Too salty — remake the sauce”
pipeline.notesHint: Optional: observations, comparison with the reference, notes for the next shift.

bulk.yieldHidden: The yield column is hidden in this journal; paste names instead
bulk.name: Name
bulk.yieldHint: Yield from the menu; adjust if different
bulk.noName: no name; this row will not be added
bulk.photoHint: For a menu on paper or a board, click “From photo” to fill in the rows automatically.
bulk.pasteAll: Paste three Excel columns at once: name, yield and time. Select the first cell and press Ctrl+V. Time can be entered without a colon: 0830 → 08:30.
bulk.pasteNameTime: Paste names and times from Excel: select the first cell and press Ctrl+V. Time can be entered without a colon: 0830 → 08:30.
bulk.pasteNameYield: Paste two Excel columns at once: name and yield. Select the first cell and press Ctrl+V.
bulk.pasteNames: Paste a column of names from Excel or a list: select the first cell and press Ctrl+V.
bulk.title: Add products as a list
bulk.description: Product table: name and yield; shared fields apply to every row.

columns.name: Finished dish name
columns.organoleptic: Results of sensory assessment of finished dish quality
columns.release: Permission to release the dish or culinary product
columns.courier: Time dishes were handed to the courier
columns.inspector: Full name of the person who performed the inspection

signatures.blockTitle: Cannot close the journal: {count, plural, one {# row is awaiting} other {# rows are awaiting}} a commission signature
signatures.blockDescription: A row’s inspection is complete when at least one commission member has signed it. Members sign using the journal QR code (PIN) or “Sign selected” on the website.
signatures.todaySigned: Today: {total, plural, one {# row} other {# rows}}, all signed by the commission
signatures.todayWaiting: Today: {total, plural, one {# row} other {# rows}}, {waiting, number} awaiting a commission signature
signatures.todayWaitingCanSign: Today: {total, plural, one {# row} other {# rows}}, {waiting, number} awaiting a commission signature — select them and click “Sign”

hygiene.summary: Morning staff examination before the shift. The production manager or head chef checks every employee and records “Cleared / Not cleared”.

materials.gloves: Disposable gloves for inspecting hands if needed

gatherStaff.title: Gather the employees
gatherStaff.detail: Gather everyone 5 minutes before the shift. Check each person: clean uniform, no hand cuts, short unpainted nails, no respiratory symptoms such as cough or runny nose, and no skin rashes.

askWellbeing.title: Ask how they feel
askWellbeing.detail: There must be no poisoning symptoms: diarrhoea, vomiting or fever. If an employee feels unwell, suspend them until recovery and a medical certificate.

recordResult.title: Record the result
recordResult.detail: Mark each employee “Cleared” or “Not cleared”. If not cleared, give the reason and destination: home, doctor or other work without food contact.

sign.title: Sign
sign.detail: Add your signature and examination time at the end. Without a signature, the entry does not count.

hygiene.completionCriteria: All shift staff checked, with a clearance decision for each, examiner’s signature and time.

mistakes.skippedEmployee: “No time to check everyone” is not acceptable. Anyone not examined cannot work.
mistakes.cutWithoutGlove: Clearing someone with a cut and no glove violates SanPiN. A cut requires a glove and a securely covered wound.
mistakes.backdatedEntry: Backdating an entry for yesterday is falsification (Russian Criminal Code, Article 327). Complete it on the examination day.

hygiene.regulationRef: SanPiN 2.3/2.4.4282-26: the organisation’s manager ensures staff examinations are performed and results recorded in the journal.

health_check.summary: The health examination is usually combined with the hygiene check: the same procedure and responsible person.
health_check.completionCriteria: All shift staff checked; journal signed and closed before the shift begins.

mistakes.clearingFever: Clearing someone with a temperature of 37 or higher.

cold_equipment_control.summary: Measure all refrigerators and freezers twice per shift, in the morning and evening.

materials.thermometer: Calibrated thermometer; see the verification journal
materials.equipmentList: List of refrigerators and their limits

cold_equipment_control.completionCriteria: All listed refrigerators measured, each temperature recorded, and actions described for deviations.

mistakes.measureThroughDoor: Measuring through a closed door is inaccurate.
mistakes.noCorrectiveAction: Omitting action taken on a deviation violates SanPiN.

cold_equipment_control.regulationRef: SanPiN 2.3/2.4.4282-26 (journal form: Appendix No. 2): temperature is checked on each refrigerator and recorded at least twice per shift.

climate_control.summary: Measure temperature and humidity in production and storage rooms twice per shift.

materials.roomList: List of rooms and their limits

placeMeter.title: Place the meter in the room centre
placeMeter.detail: Avoid doors, ventilation and sunlight. Wait 1–2 minutes for the reading to stabilise.

recordReadings.title: Record readings
recordReadings.detail: Record temperature and humidity for each room. Production limits: 17–23°C, 40–70% humidity. Cold store: up to +6°C.

correctDeviation.title: Act on deviations
correctDeviation.detail: Open or close a window, check ventilation or call an engineer. Record the action.

climate_control.completionCriteria: All rooms measured and measures recorded for deviations.

cleaning.summary: Record cleaning of each production area before and after the shift.
cleaning.completionCriteria: The area is visibly clean, surfaces dry and the journal signed by the cleaner and checker.

mistakes.sharedMop: Using one mop for all areas causes cross-contamination.
mistakes.insufficientContactTime: Without the required contact time, the detergent does not work.
mistakes.missingCheckerSignature: Omitting the checker’s signature makes the entry invalid.

cleaning.regulationRef: SanPiN 2.3/2.4.4282-26: production and auxiliary rooms are cleaned according to schedule.

finished_product.summary: Check every prepared dish before service. The cook or a 3-person commission assesses quality and decides: clear, rework or reject.

materials.recipeStandards: Reference dish descriptions and process sheets

decideRelease.title: Make the decision
decideRelease.detail: “Clear for service”, “Rework” (cook further or add salt) or “Reject” (write off). Record the decision and reason if not cleared.

finished_product.completionCriteria: Every dish checked against 4 parameters, with temperature and decision; rejected dishes have a reason.

mistakes.sharedSpoon: Tasting several dishes with one spoon causes cross-contamination.
mistakes.warmHotDish: Clearing warm “hot food” at 45–60°C provides ideal conditions for bacteria.
mistakes.missingReworkReason: Not recording the reason for rework.

finished_product.regulationRef: SanPiN 2.3/2.4.4282-26: finished food is checked before every service and results recorded in the journal.

incoming_control.summary: Receive each supplier batch by checking documents, temperature, labels and goods condition.

decideReceipt.title: Make the decision
decideReceipt.detail: “Accepted”: book into stock. “Returned”: always state the reason, such as expiry, damaged packaging, temperature or missing documents.

incoming_control.completionCriteria: Every delivery-note item checked and a decision recorded; returns have a reason and supplier return documents.

mistakes.missingBatch: Omitting the batch number makes later tracing impossible.
mistakes.acceptingExpired: Not returning expired goods can lead to criminal liability if poisoning occurs.

incoming_control.regulationRef: SanPiN 2.3/2.4.4282-26 and HACCP CCP1: incoming raw materials and food must comply with regulatory documentation.

intensive_cooling.summary: Monitor rapid cooling of hot dishes. Under SanPiN, food must cool from +65°C to +5°C within ≤ 2 hours.

explainDelay.title: Explain if cooling exceeds 2 hours
explainDelay.detail: State the cause (large volume or thick container) and measures (smaller portions or blast chilling). Repeated cases require reviewing the process.

intensive_cooling.completionCriteria: t0, t1, initial and final temperatures and duration are entered. If > 2 hours, cause and measures are recorded.

mistakes.sealedHotContainer: A tightly sealed hot container heats the refrigerator and will not cool properly.
mistakes.exceededDuration: Exceeding 2 hours keeps food in the dangerous temperature zone where bacteria grow.

intensive_cooling.regulationRef: SanPiN 2.3/2.4.4282-26: prepared dishes are rapidly cooled from +65°C to +5°C within no more than 2 hours.

fryer_oil.summary: Check frying oil quality at every start: assess colour and smell or polar compounds.
fryer_oil.completionCriteria: An entry for every fryer start, oil condition recorded and a reason for any replacement.

mistakes.darkOil: Using dark oil a little longer releases acrylamides.
mistakes.unwashedFryer: Not washing the fryer before adding fresh oil.

disinfectant_usage.summary: Track disinfectant use; record each treatment separately.
disinfectant_usage.completionCriteria: The entry includes product, concentration, treated area, time and signature.

mistakes.undilutedSolution: An undiluted, overly concentrated solution can leave residues in food.
mistakes.insufficientContactTime: Not allowing the required contact time.

ppe_issuance.summary: Issue PPE (gloves, aprons, masks and headwear) to staff. The commodity expert or production manager makes ONE entry covering all issues.
ppe_issuance.completionCriteria: Every PPE recipient has an entry and signature.

mistakes.unsignedIssue: Issuing without a signature leaves no evidence.
mistakes.noReplacement: Failing to replace worn PPE violates occupational safety.

staff_training.summary: Record briefings conducted by the training manager or production manager.

materials.programme: Briefing programme: induction, initial, refresher or unscheduled

staff_training.completionCriteria: Every employee has a record of their latest briefing and has signed.

mistakes.missingInduction: Skipping induction for a new employee is immediately apparent to Rospotrebnadzor.

med_books.summary: Medical book register. The manager or HR monitors validity dates.

materials.register: Medical book journal or system register
materials.books: Employees’ medical books, held by staff or in the office

med_books.completionCriteria: Every active employee has a current, valid medical book.

mistakes.expiredBook: Allowing work with an expired book can entail criminal liability.
mistakes.untrackedExpiry: Failure to track expiry leads to a Rospotrebnadzor fine.

med_books.regulationRef: SanPiN 2.3/2.4.4282-26 and Ministry of Health Order No. 29n.

equipment_cleaning.summary: Record washing and disinfection of equipment, such as cookers, mincers, mixers, tables and fryers, after the shift or according to schedule. The cook or kitchen cleaner records each wash.

materials.detergent: Detergent (Ph Multiclean, Nika-2 or equivalent) at the manufacturer’s concentration
materials.disinfectant: Disinfectant (Ph Dez-5, Javel-Solid or Deochlor), usually 0.05–0.1% active chlorine
materials.tools: Brushes and cloths, separate for equipment and floors

dryAndAssemble.title: Dry and reassemble
dryAndAssemble.detail: Air-dry or use a clean disposable paper towel. Reassemble, connect and check operation.

recordCleaning.title: Record in the journal
recordCleaning.detail: Time, specific equipment, detergent name and concentration, disinfectant name and concentration, rinse temperature and worker’s full name.

equipment_cleaning.completionCriteria: Equipment is visibly clean, odour-free, rinsed with water ≥ 65°C, disinfected, assembled and working. All parameters are recorded.

mistakes.noPrewash: Using disinfectant before washing: chlorine does not work on fat or protein because organic matter binds it.
mistakes.immediateRinsing: Rinsing disinfectant off immediately gives it no time to work. If instructions require 30 minutes, wait 30 minutes.
mistakes.mixingChemicals: Mixing detergents or disinfectants can release chlorine gas, which is hazardous.
mistakes.missingRinseTemperature: Forgetting rinse temperature: below 65°C, protein residues stick and microorganisms survive.

equipment_cleaning.regulationRef: SanPiN 2.3/2.4.4282-26: production rooms and equipment are cleaned using detergents and disinfectants. HACCP CCP3 treats equipment sanitation as a critical control point.

perishable_rejection.summary: Incoming acceptance journal for perishable raw materials and semi-finished products with limited shelf life, including dairy, meat, fish and vegetables. The commodity expert or head chef records EVERY batch on receipt.

materials.qualityDocuments: Quality certificate or declaration of conformity

decideReceipt.title: Make the decision
decideReceipt.detail: “Accepted”: book into stock with batch and expiry details. “Rejected”: prepare a supplier return report with the reason.

perishable_rejection.completionCriteria: Every delivery-note item checked, temperatures and dates recorded, with an acceptance or rejection decision and reason.

mistakes.noTemperatureCheck: The main mistake is accepting without measuring temperature. Perishables without a cold chain are dangerous.
mistakes.trustingVerbalAssurance: Do not rely on the supplier’s word: a batch without a quality certificate must not be accepted.
mistakes.missingBatch: Without a recorded batch, the source of poisoning cannot be traced.
mistakes.lateEntry: Complete the journal on receipt day; do not backdate.

perishable_rejection.regulationRef: SanPiN 2.3/2.4.4282-26; Customs Union Technical Regulation 021/2011, “Food safety”; HACCP CCP1, incoming raw-material inspection.

complaint_register.summary: Consumer complaint register. Record every verbal or written complaint on the day received, with time, complainant’s full name, issue and measures taken.

materials.feedbackBook: Separate comments and suggestions book, if available

contactComplainant.title: Contact the complainant
contactComplainant.detail: If contact details were provided, call or write with the outcome within 7 days (maximum 10 days under consumer protection law). Record notification.

complaint_register.completionCriteria: Complaint recorded on receipt day, passed to the manager, measures and outcome recorded, complainant informed.

mistakes.ignoredMinorComplaint: Every complaint must be recorded, even a minor one. The law does not rank complaints by importance.
mistakes.unexplainedRejection: Writing “Complaint rejected” without reasons: Rospotrebnadzor examines substance, not form.
mistakes.hiddenPoisoningComplaint: Failing to notify management that day about a poisoning complaint entails criminal liability for concealment.
mistakes.forgottenPromise: Promising a fix in 5 minutes and forgetting leads to escalation.

complaint_register.regulationRef: Russian Consumer Protection Law, Article 22; Government Resolution No. 1515 of 21.09.2020, “Rules for catering services”. SanPiN 2.3/2.4.4282-26 requires a complaint journal in catering.

daily_samples.summary: A retained sample is a portion of every dish kept for two days in case of a poisoning investigation. The cook takes it immediately after cooking.

materials.spoons: A separate spoon for each dish

disposeAfterRetention.title: Dispose after 48 hours
disposeAfterRetention.detail: Discard samples, wash the jars and record the disposal time in the row.

daily_samples.completionCriteria: Samples of all dishes from the meal are refrigerated, one journal row per dish, and disposal recorded for older samples.

mistakes.sharedJar: Using one jar for several dishes.
mistakes.missingLabel: Without a label, the sampling day is unknown.

daily_samples.regulationRef: SanPiN 2.3/2.4.4282-26: food service requirements for children’s and medical organisations; the clause number needs legal verification.

vitaminization.summary: Add vitamins to the third course or sweet dish, such as compote or kissel, before service. The cook or nurse immediately records dose and time.
vitaminization.completionCriteria: Entry made on the day of vitamin addition, with addition time before serving time.

mistakes.estimatedDose: Estimating the dose without calculating portions.

vitaminization.regulationRef: SanPiN 2.3/2.4.4282-26: food service in children’s and medical organisations; the clause number needs legal verification.

ration_control.summary: Every 10 days or monthly, compare actual food-group consumption per person with the norm.

materials.consumptionRecords: Cumulative statement or menu requisitions for the period
materials.norms: Table of norms by food group

ration_control.completionCriteria: Each food group has a row showing the period’s norm, actual amount and deviation.

mistakes.totalInsteadOfPerPerson: Calculating for everyone rather than per person.

ration_control.regulationRef: SanPiN 2.3/2.4.4282-26: dietary norms in children’s and medical organisations; the clause number needs legal verification.

transport_temperature.summary: For every trip, measure product temperature twice, at loading and unloading, and record it.

materials.thermometer: Clean probe thermometer, wiped with a cloth after each measurement

transport_temperature.completionCriteria: Each trip has two temperatures and a route.

mistakes.measuringAir: Measuring cargo-area air instead of the product.

transport_temperature.regulationRef: Customs Union Technical Regulation 021/2011, Article 10: HACCP procedures and records.

tableware_breakage.summary: When dishes break, clear fragments first, then record what broke, where and why.

materials.fragmentContainer: Strong bag or box for fragments

tableware_breakage.completionCriteria: Fragments removed and an entry made during the same shift.

mistakes.ordinaryBag: Putting fragments in an ordinary bag can cut the cleaner.
mistakes.uncheckedNearbyFood: Not checking food near the breakage.

pool_water_control.summary: Check pool water before opening and throughout the day as scheduled: temperature, chlorine, pH and clarity. Close the pool until any out-of-range result is corrected.

materials.tester: Photometer or drop-test kit for free and combined chlorine and pH

pool_water_control.completionCriteria: Opening readings taken and recorded, later checks on schedule and deviations addressed.

mistakes.nearDosingNozzle: Sampling by the chlorine dosing nozzle gives an inflated reading.
mistakes.openingBeforeResults: Opening the pool before results are available.
mistakes.missingVisitorCount: Without visitor count, there is no load comparison.

pool_water_control.regulationRef: Sanitary Rules 2.1.3678-20: pool operation requirements; wording needs legal review.

inventory_condition.summary: Inspect knives, boards, spatulas, containers and other utensils on schedule for chips, cracks, rust and peeling. Remove damaged items from use immediately and record them.
inventory_condition.completionCriteria: All area utensils inspected; damaged items withdrawn and recorded.

mistakes.usingCrackedBoard: Keeping a cracked board until a replacement arrives lets bacteria accumulate and plastic fragments enter food.
mistakes.uncheckedOtherShift: Writing “All sound” without inspecting utensils used by another shift.

instrument_sterilization.summary: Record every steriliser load: instruments, method, cycle settings and whether the indicator activated. Without a record, instruments are considered non-sterile.

materials.instruments: Instruments after disinfection and pre-sterilisation cleaning
materials.steriliser: Dry-heat steriliser, autoclave or chemical sterilisation solution

instrument_sterilization.completionCriteria: Every cycle has a row with settings and indicator result.

mistakes.noPrecleaning: Sterilising without prior disinfection and cleaning.
mistakes.openingEarly: Opening the dry-heat steriliser before the cycle ends.
mistakes.unrecordedFailedIndicator: Omitting a cycle where the indicator failed.

instrument_sterilization.regulationRef: SanPiN 2.1.3678-20: requirements for organisations providing personal services.

medical_waste_b.summary: Collect procedure waste that may have contacted blood, such as needles, cotton pads and disposables, separately. Disinfect it and record the quantity and recipient.

materials.yellowPackaging: Yellow bags and yellow sharps containers

medical_waste_b.completionCriteria: Each waste package is recorded and handed over under contract.

mistakes.needlesInGeneralWaste: Throwing used needles into ordinary waste.
mistakes.overfilledSharps: Overfilling a sharps container: close it when three-quarters full.

batch_release.summary: Check each finished-product batch before dispatch and decide whether to release it. Record the decision and the checks performed.
batch_release.completionCriteria: Every dispatched batch has a “Released” record.

mistakes.uncheckedLabel: Dispatching a batch before checking its labelling.
mistakes.unrecordedRejection: Not recording a rejected batch, losing the history of nonconformities.

batch_release.regulationRef: TR CU 021/2011, Article 10: HACCP procedures and their records.

accident_journal.summary: Record accidents, emergencies and injuries in food production: power or water outages, refrigerator failures, glass in food, employee burns or cuts, and guest food poisoning. The shift supervisor completes the log IMMEDIATELY when an incident occurs.

materials.contacts: Manager and emergency service contacts (sanitary service, ambulance)
materials.footage: CCTV cameras, if available: preserve the footage

investigate.title: Investigate
investigate.body: Analyse the causes within 3 days. Define corrective actions to prevent recurrence. Record everything: Rospotrebnadzor checks the “accident → analysis → action” cycle.

accident_journal.completionCriteria: The accident is recorded on the day it occurs, the product is isolated, management is notified, and an investigation with corrective actions is completed.

mistakes.servingUnsafeFood: “Serve it; nobody will notice” after glass or chemicals enter food. Releasing unsafe products falls under Article 238 of the Russian Criminal Code.
mistakes.noSanitaryNotification: Not calling the sanitary service when guest food poisoning is suspected violates Article 50 of Federal Law No. 52.
mistakes.formalCause: Writing “everything is fine” instead of actual causes. Rospotrebnadzor checks the analysis cycle; formal entries lead to fines.
mistakes.falseDate: Falsifying the accident date is document forgery (Criminal Code, Article 327).

accident_journal.regulationRef: Federal Law No. 52 “On the sanitary and epidemiological welfare of the population”, Articles 11, 50. Russian Labour Code, Articles 227-231 (investigating workplace accidents). SanPiN 2.3/2.4.4282-26.

uv_lamp_runtime.summary: Record germicidal UV lamp use. The lamp sterilises workshop air on a schedule, usually before the shift and on the sanitation day. Record start time, duration and total lamp hours to replace it when its service life ends.

materials.passport: Lamp technical passport stating its service life, usually 8000 operating hours

recordHours.title: Record accumulated operating hours
recordHours.body: Add today’s hours to the accumulated total. Replace the lamp at 8000 hours, or the limit in its technical passport.

uv_lamp_runtime.completionCriteria: Date, switch-on/off times, duration, room, operator’s full name and accumulated lamp hours are recorded.

mistakes.peoplePresent: Switching on the lamp while people are present can burn the retina and skin.
mistakes.noHourTracking: Not tracking hours: after 8000 hours the lamp loses intensity and no longer sterilises effectively, although it still appears to work.
mistakes.noVentilation: Not ventilating afterwards: ozone harms the respiratory system.
mistakes.wrongLamp: Using a UV-A tanning lamp instead of a germicidal UV-C lamp is ineffective.

uv_lamp_runtime.regulationRef: R 3.5.1904-04 “Use of ultraviolet germicidal radiation for indoor air disinfection”. SanPiN 2.3/2.4.4282-26. HACCP CCP3: air disinfection in production rooms.

general_cleaning.summary: Schedule and record deep cleaning once a week. This includes washing walls and ceilings, disinfecting everything and dismantling refrigerators for cleaning. The cleaner or cook completes the log; the chef or production manager checks it.

materials.schedule: Deep-cleaning schedule displayed on the wall and approved by the manager
materials.chemicals: Complete set of detergents and disinfectants
materials.tools: Stepladder for ceilings, hose and brushes

recordCleaning.title: Enter the work in the log
recordCleaning.body: Record the date, room, exact work performed, products and concentrations, worker’s full name and checker’s full name. The manager signs.

general_cleaning.completionCriteria: The room is clean from ceiling to floor, refrigerators are dismantled and disinfected, and the worker and checker have signed the log.

mistakes.dailyAsDeep: Treating daily cleaning as deep cleaning. Daily cleaning covers surfaces; deep cleaning includes dismantling.
mistakes.monthlyOnly: Cleaning monthly instead of weekly violates SanPiN clause 2.16.
mistakes.untreatedWalls: Not disinfecting walls: pathogens live in splashes on walls as well as on floors.
mistakes.falseSignature: Signing without doing the work is falsification. Rospotrebnadzor takes swabs; dirty results alongside “all clear” records multiply the fines.

general_cleaning.regulationRef: SanPiN 2.3/2.4.4282-26: deep cleaning at least once a week. HACCP CCP3: room sanitation.

cleaning_ventilation_checklist.summary: Checklist for cleaning ventilation systems: extraction hoods, ducts and grease traps. Internal checks are monthly; professional cleaning by a contracted company is quarterly. Without this, fire and sanitation risks arise.

quarterlyContractor.title: Arrange quarterly contractor cleaning
quarterlyContractor.body: Have ducts professionally dismantled and cleaned. Obtain and file the work report with the log. Without it, Rospotrebnadzor and the fire inspectorate issue violation reports.

cleaning_ventilation_checklist.completionCriteria: Grease traps are clean, airflow is normal, and monthly records and quarterly contractor reports are filed.

mistakes.dirtyGreaseTraps: Not cleaning grease traps violates fire safety and is the most common cause of kitchen fires.
mistakes.exteriorOnly: Assuming a clean exterior means everything is fine: layers of grease inside ducts can ignite from a spark.
mistakes.noContractor: Working without a contractor: ordinary cleaners lack the tools and authorisation to dismantle ducts.

cleaning_ventilation_checklist.regulationRef: SanPiN 2.3/2.4.4282-26. Russian Government Resolution No. 1479 “Fire safety regulations”. SP 4.13130.2013. Missing reports lead to fines from both Rospotrebnadzor and the fire inspectorate.

glass_control.summary: Check glass and brittle plastic items. Before each shift, inspect dishes, bulbs and containers for chips and cracks. Any glass near food is a potential physical contaminant (HACCP CCP/CCP1).

materials.inventory: Kitchen brittle-items inventory, maintained separately as glass_items_list

glass_control.completionCriteria: The complete inventory has been checked, every glass item inspected, defects recorded and corrected, and the log signed.

mistakes.noInventory: Not keeping a glass inventory makes checks impossible. Rospotrebnadzor issues a violation report without one.
mistakes.crackedDishes: Continuing to use cracked dishes lets glass fragments enter food, causing physical contamination.
mistakes.unprotectedLamps: Leaving lamps unprotected was a major cause of mass food-poisoning incidents in Soviet kitchens, with broken glass in soup.

glass_control.regulationRef: TR CU 021/2011, Article 10 (production process requirements). HACCP CCP1: physical hazards. SanPiN 2.3/2.4.4282-26.

equipment_maintenance.summary: Schedule preventive maintenance for production equipment: cookers, fryers, refrigerators, mixers, mincers and dishwashers. Follow each manufacturer’s maintenance schedule. Record the work, date and person responsible.

materials.passports: Equipment technical passports with maintenance schedules
materials.contract: Service company contract for outsourced maintenance

equipment_maintenance.completionCriteria: All scheduled maintenance is completed on time, the log is filled in and reports are filed.

mistakes.waitForFailure: “It works, so it is fine”: ignoring maintenance until failure, which then happens at the busiest moment.
mistakes.unqualifiedWork: Doing complex maintenance yourself without qualifications can cause electrical failure or fire.
mistakes.noLog: Not keeping a log: Rospotrebnadzor and fire inspectors require proof of compliance with the schedule.

equipment_maintenance.regulationRef: TR CU 021/2011. SP 2.3.6.1066-01. Russian Government Resolution No. 1479 (fire safety). Equipment technical passports are legal documents.

equipment_calibration.summary: Schedule metrological verification for measuring instruments such as thermometers, scales and pressure gauges. Instruments affecting food safety must be verified by an accredited laboratory on schedule. Without verification, measurements are invalid.

materials.inventory: List of all measuring instruments in the kitchen

labelInstruments.title: Label the instruments
labelInstruments.body: Attach a label with the next verification date so users can immediately see whether verification has expired.

equipment_calibration.completionCriteria: Every instrument has a valid certificate, the log is up to date, and instruments with expired verification are not used in production.

mistakes.unverifiedUse: “It still works”: using an unverified thermometer makes all its measurements legally invalid.
mistakes.selfVerification: Checking it yourself does not count. Only an accredited laboratory can verify it.
mistakes.noLabel: Not labelling an instrument lets a cook use an overdue thermometer and enter its readings in the log.

equipment_calibration.regulationRef: Federal Law No. 102 “On ensuring uniformity of measurements”. Russian Government Resolution No. 250 of 02.04.2015 (instrument verification). SanPiN 2.3/2.4.4282-26.

breakdown_history.summary: Maintain a breakdown history card for each piece of equipment, recording every breakdown and repair. It helps assess service life and plan replacement.

materials.card: Separate breakdown history card for each piece of equipment

breakdown_history.completionCriteria: Each piece of equipment has a card with its complete breakdown and repair history.

mistakes.noCard: Not keeping the card: undocumented repair expenses lead to additional tax assessments during a tax audit.
mistakes.undocumentedRepair: Writing off inexpensive repairs without paperwork violates accounting rules.

breakdown_history.regulationRef: Accounting Regulation PBU 6/01 “Accounting for fixed assets”. TR CU 021/2011 (monitoring equipment condition).

metal_impurity.summary: Record metal impurities in raw materials at food plants using mechanical processing, such as flour, cereals and dried herbs. Raw materials pass through a magnetic separator or metal detector; collected metal fragments are weighed.

recordFindings.title: Record the findings
recordFindings.body: Record date, batch supplier and number, collected mass, particle size and action: continue work, return to supplier or send to a laboratory.

metal_impurity.completionCriteria: Every batch has a record of metal impurity mass, compliance with limits and actions taken.

mistakes.dirtyMagnet: Not cleaning the magnet between shifts: accumulated material distorts the records.
mistakes.ignoredLargeObject: Ignoring a nail or nut: this is a supplier emergency requiring return and a claim.

metal_impurity.regulationRef: TR CU 021/2011, Article 10. HACCP CCP1: physical hazards. GOST 26927-86 “Raw materials and food products. Method for determining metal impurities”.

traceability_test.summary: Product traceability log. For any sold dish, trace ALL ingredients back to the supplier, batch number and receipt date; also trace where each batch went. Run a quarterly exercise: choose a dish and reconstruct the entire chain.

materials.invoices: Raw-material invoices covering up to 6 months

recordResults.title: Record the results
recordResults.body: Record the test date, selected dish, sale number, reconstructed batches, reconstruction time, problems found and corrective actions.

traceability_test.completionCriteria: The exercise is completed, the chain reconstructed within a reasonable time, problems recorded and an improvement plan prepared.

mistakes.noTest: Not testing: Rospotrebnadzor WILL ask to reconstruct the chain during inspection and will fine you if it cannot be done.
mistakes.noBatchNumbers: Reconstructing without batch numbers is useless when a supplier recalls a batch.
mistakes.fakeExercise: Recording “everything is fine” without an actual exercise is falsification.

traceability_test.regulationRef: TR CU 021/2011, Article 10 “Traceability”. HACCP is mandatory (GOST R 51705.1-2001). SanPiN 2.3/2.4.4282-26.

product_writeoff.summary: A rejection report documents the write-off of unusable products: expired, spoiled, broken or made in breach of process requirements. EVERY write-off needs a separate report signed by the commission. Without it, the write-off is a shortage, with accounting and personal income tax consequences for the financially responsible person.

materials.form: Printed rejection report form: standard TORG-15 / TORG-16 or an approved in-house form
materials.register: Rejection report log, a chronological register of all reports
materials.scales: Scales for weighing products written off

fileReport.title: File the report
fileReport.body: Send the original to accounting for inventory write-off, a copy to the log and a copy to the production file. Retain for 5 years under accounting rules.

product_writeoff.completionCriteria: Every write-off has a report with commission signatures, reason, weight and value; the log is chronological.

mistakes.noReport: Writing off products quietly without a report creates a shortage and personal liability for the financially responsible person.
mistakes.backdatedReport: Backdating a report is an accounting and tax error.
mistakes.takingHome: Taking written-off food home “for the dog” violates sanitation rules. If a relative is poisoned, criminal liability may follow.

product_writeoff.regulationRef: Federal Law No. 402 “On accounting”. Russian State Statistics Committee Resolution No. 132 (TORG-15, TORG-16 forms). Russian Tax Code, Article 250 (non-operating income from shortages). SanPiN 2.3/2.4.4282-26.

incoming_raw_materials_control.summary: Goods receipt and incoming inspection log, an expanded version of `incoming_control` for plants handling large raw-material volumes. Record EVERY invoice: date, supplier, items, batches, temperatures, documents and decision.

materials.certificates: Supplier declarations of conformity and quality certificates

acceptOrReturn.title: Accept or return
acceptOrReturn.body: “Accepted”: register receipt with the batch number. “Returned”: prepare a return report stating the reasons, enter it in the log and send a claim to the supplier.

incoming_raw_materials_control.completionCriteria: Every invoice is fully recorded, each batch has a decision, temperatures and dates are documented, and paperwork is filed.

mistakes.trustingWithoutMeasurement: Accepting on trust without measuring is the main cause of problems with perishable goods.
mistakes.noBatchRecord: Not recording the batch makes recall impossible if a defect is found.
mistakes.noDeclaration: Ignoring the declaration: without it, the batch is illegal in Russia.

incoming_raw_materials_control.regulationRef: TR CU 021/2011, Article 10. SanPiN 2.3/2.4.4282-26. Russian Law No. 29 “On food quality and safety”.

sanitary_day_control.summary: Monitor the sanitation day: at least once a month, close to guests for a day of deep sanitation. Record the plan, work performed and results.

materials.schedule: Sanitation-day schedule approved by the manager
materials.reports: Completed-work reports if an external cleaning company is hired

recordWork.title: Record the work
recordWork.body: Record the date, checklist tasks completed, workers and checkers. Attach copies of contractor reports.

sanitary_day_control.completionCriteria: The sanitation day follows the schedule and covers all rooms, the log is completed and contractor reports are filed.

mistakes.unrecordedWork: “We will do it on a day off without recording it”: it is not formally accounted for, so Rospotrebnadzor treats it as not done.
mistakes.tooInfrequent: Doing it once every six months violates SanPiN.
mistakes.noGuestNotice: Not notifying guests: they may arrive, damaging your reputation.

sanitary_day_control.regulationRef: SanPiN 2.3/2.4.4282-26. Guidelines MR 2.3.6.0233-21 “Recommendations for sanitation procedures”.

audit_plan.summary: Annual internal HACCP audit programme. Management approves the audits, auditors and dates once a year. Without a plan, audits are isolated events rather than a system.

materials.plan: Current-year programme on paper, approved by the director
materials.checklists: Audit checklist templates for each area

approvePlan.title: Approve the plan
approvePlan.body: The director signs the plan. Display one copy by the manager’s workstation and file another in the audit folder.

audit_plan.completionCriteria: The annual plan is approved, covers all CCPs, assigns auditors and dates, and includes prepared checklists.

mistakes.noPlan: Auditing without a plan: Rospotrebnadzor will treat this as having no audit system.
mistakes.selfAudit: An auditor checking their own area creates a conflict of interest and invalidates the protocol.
mistakes.noTrainingRecord: Not documenting auditor training: without a HACCP training certificate, the audit is merely formal.

audit_plan.regulationRef: GOST R 51705.1-2001 “Quality systems. Food quality management based on HACCP principles. General requirements”. GOST R ISO 19011-2021 “Guidelines for auditing”.

audit_protocol.summary: The internal audit protocol is the auditor’s working document during inspection. Complete it AS THE AUDIT PROCEEDS: checks performed, conformities, violations and evidence collected.

materials.checklist: Audit checklist from the audit programme
materials.recordingTools: Pen and optional voice recorder for interviews

signProtocol.title: Sign the protocol
signProtocol.body: The auditor and a representative of the audited area sign. Record the finish time and signatures.

audit_protocol.completionCriteria: Every checklist item is completed, nonconformities have evidence and categories, and the protocol is signed.

mistakes.noInspection: Writing “everything is fine” without inspecting is a pointless, formal audit.
mistakes.noPhotos: Not taking photos: without evidence, a nonconformity can easily be disputed.
mistakes.missingSignature: Not obtaining the audited party’s signature invalidates the protocol.

audit_protocol.regulationRef: GOST R ISO 19011-2021, sections 6.4-6.5. GOST R 51705.1-2001, clause 4.6.

audit_report.summary: An internal audit report presents the audit results to management: conclusions, nonconformities, recommendations, correction deadlines and responsible people.

followUp.title: Follow up on actions
followUp.body: Recheck after the correction deadline. Escalate unresolved issues to the director.

audit_report.completionCriteria: The report is complete, every nonconformity has corrective actions, management has received it and implementation is monitored.

mistakes.formalActions: Writing generic actions such as “provide training” without analysing causes lets the violation recur.
mistakes.unverifiedClosure: Not monitoring implementation and marking issues “closed” without checking.
mistakes.noManagementReport: Not passing the report to management: an audit without decisions is useless.

audit_report.regulationRef: GOST R ISO 19011-2021, section 6.6. GOST R 51705.1-2001, clause 4.6.

training_plan.summary: Annual staff training plan. Management approves who is trained, on which subjects and in which format. Basic hygiene and HACCP training is mandatory for all new staff and annually for existing staff.

materials.plan: Annual training plan approved by the director
materials.log: Training log, a separate staff_training document

approveAndMonitor.title: Approve and monitor
approveAndMonitor.body: The director signs the plan. The production manager monitors completion using the staff_training log.

training_plan.completionCriteria: The annual plan is approved, covers mandatory subjects for every staff group, and includes a training programme and implementation monitoring.

mistakes.paperOnlyPlan: Signing a plan just to tick a box without training: Rospotrebnadzor asks a cook what they learned, and inability to answer leads to a fine.
mistakes.delayedNewStaffTraining: Waiting for scheduled training to train new staff violates requirements. New employees must not work without basic training.
mistakes.noTrainingLog: Not maintaining a training log alongside the plan: a plan without actual records is just paper.

training_plan.regulationRef: Russian Labour Code, Articles 212-225 (occupational safety and training). SanPiN 2.3/2.4.4282-26. Ministry of Health Order No. 29n (medical examinations). GOST R 51705.1-2001, clause 4.4 (staff competence).

glass_items_list.summary: Inventory glass and brittle items in production: all potential sources of physical contamination, including dishes, containers, bulbs and thermometers. Used by the glass_control log.

materials.inventory: Inventory sheet: number / name / location / quantity

updateInventory.title: Update when things change
updateInventory.body: Add newly purchased spice jars. Write off broken dishes and remove them from the list. Keep the inventory a living document.

glass_items_list.completionCriteria: All glass and brittle items are numbered and inventoried with their locations, and the inventory is current.

mistakes.staleInventory: Making an inventory once and forgetting it: without updates it becomes useless within a month.
mistakes.overlookedSmallItems: Skipping “minor” items such as bulbs and thermometers. Small items are the most dangerous sources of physical contamination.
mistakes.noNumbers: Not numbering items makes it impossible to detect a missing item during daily checks.

glass_items_list.regulationRef: HACCP CCP1: identifying physical hazards. TR CU 021/2011. SanPiN 2.3/2.4.4282-26.

pest_control.summary: Disinfection, insect control and rodent control log. Inspect internally for signs of rodents and insects monthly. A specialist company performs treatment quarterly.

materials.contract: Contract with a specialist sanitary service or licensed company

followUpInspection.title: Perform a follow-up inspection
followUpInspection.body: Inspect again 7-10 days after treatment. If signs remain, arrange repeat treatment at the contractor’s expense under the contract.

pest_control.completionCriteria: Monthly inspections are logged, quarterly treatment reports filed and responses to findings recorded.

mistakes.noLog: Not keeping a log: Rospotrebnadzor issues a fine regardless of whether pests are present.
mistakes.selfTreatment: Treating with your own products: only a licensed company is permitted to treat food production facilities.
mistakes.poisonBaitsIndoors: Using poison baits inside the kitchen is strictly prohibited by SanPiN.
mistakes.missingReports: Not retaining reports: without them, a tick in the log has no supporting evidence.

pest_control.regulationRef: SanPiN 3.5.2.3472-17 “Sanitary and epidemiological requirements for organising and conducting insect control”. SanPiN 3.5.3.3223-14 (rodent control). SanPiN 2.3/2.4.4282-26. Contracts and reports are required for Rospotrebnadzor acceptance.

page.expiredLink: This link has expired. Ask your administrator to resend the task.
page.damagedLink: The token is damaged or does not match this task.

actions.yesterdayDifferent: Yesterday’s structure is different. Fill in the fields manually.

form.sharedHint: You can add several entries. The task stays open until the end of the shift.
form.editingHint: You are editing a saved journal entry. Confirming will replace the previous values.
form.normalHint: Uses the midpoint of the normal range for measurements and checks all boxes
form.noFields: There are no fields to fill in. Just confirm completion.
form.completeChecklist: Check all required checklist items first

success.sharedHint: Entries today: {count, number}. You can add another entry or close the shift for this journal.
success.closeShift: End the shift for this journal
success.title: Journal filled in
success.personalHint: The entry is saved in WeSetup. The TasksFlow task is marked as completed.

noEvents.description: Give a reason. The journal will be closed for today and the manager will see “no events”.

alreadyDone.title: Task completed
